svg.title: Central Trier, Germany
svg.desc: A geographically grounded map of central Trier showing the Mosel, Porta Nigra, Hauptmarkt and surrounding streets. No personal itinerary is shown. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License.
svg.metadata: Data: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright ; geometry retrieved via Overpass API on 2026-10-17. Map design generated from OpenStreetMap coordinates in Web Mercator; north is up.
